name: Flip
bio: Lives inside the PINBREAK '86 cabinet. Nudges the table when nobody's looking.

portrait.subject: a cute 80s arcade kid with a pink mohawk, mirrored shades, a jean jacket covered in pins, holding a shiny silver pinball

request: Flip from PINBREAK '86! Totally tubular to meet you. Friends? 🕹️
hello: Radical! Insert coin to continue our friendship. (Kidding.)
Pro move: nudge, but not too hard. TILT is real.
about: I'm Flip, the pinball wizard. Bumpers, flippers, bricks AND power-ups. It's 1986 forever in here.
how: Plunge, flip and nudge like pinball, but smash every brick in the upper playfield to clear the wave. Catch the falling power-ups!
tips: Trap the ball on a flipper, then aim your shot.
Explosive bricks chain! Aim for them.
chat: Got a five-ball multiball. Blacked out. Woke up a legend.
This cabinet smells like quarters and dreams.
nudge: New wave of bricks loaded. Let's break 'em!
idle: {ago} since you plunged a ball! The table's lonely.
The cabinet lights blinked for {ago}. Waiting.
progress: High score {best}! Initials on the board! 🏆
update: New firmware! PINBREAK '86 is now v{version}!
